lead: Cinematic sci-fi film still, frontier exoplanet, deep teal and fiery orange light.
notes: Mood-only mini images for City Buster.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen "City Buster-mini" --model sdxl --max 999, then finish "City Buster-mini" --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: helios
images.prompt: A lawless frontier colony town on an alien planet, mines, factories and power plants run by gangsters.

images.name: paddle
images.prompt: A long flat experimental warship hovering in orbit above a planet, a glowing energy orb beside it.

images.name: orbs
images.prompt: Glowing energy orbs falling from the sky into a city, craters and fires blooming where they land.

images.name: gang
images.prompt: A fortified industrial compound on a dusty alien planet at night, fuel tanks, silos and floodlights, seen from above.

images.name: starmap
images.prompt: A rough holographic star map of frontier star systems, three planets marked in warning colors.

images.name: flow
images.prompt: A small crew in a dim warship cockpit, looking down at a burning city through the window.

images.name: slap
images.prompt: A glowing energy orb struck hard by a metal hull, flying off at speed with a bright trail.

images.name: charge
images.prompt: Several glowing orbs over a city all bursting with energy blasts at the same moment.

images.name: targets
images.prompt: Fuel tanks and giant batteries buried in rock exploding, fireballs and lightning flying upward.

images.name: stage
images.prompt: A cross-section of alien ground, layers of sand, soil, stone and bedrock with caves, tunnels and buildings on top.
